diagnosis.root_cause: ESC shader HUD plane previously encoded VRPauseMenuVerticalOffset into HUD clip matrix BEFORE head inverse, individual eye inverse and asymmetric projection, while its sibling XYZRHW pause shell applies a fixed screen-space pixel shift AFTER eye transform.
diagnosis.source_evidence: R30BuildScreenSpaceEyeConstants assigned hudScale._42=pauseClipShift, whereas R30 XYZRHW pauseBiasY added height*VRPauseMenuVerticalOffset in eye pixel space.
diagnosis.fix_evidence: Apply source-signed NDC shift to final per-eye shader projection by clipY += NDCshift * clipW; unchanged main optical plane and source scale.
diagnosis.negative_test_evidence: Portable numerical C++ native test covers two distinct perspective eye matrices, signed offset, neutral/NaN, and invariant X/W/depth.
